instruction: Grab the palm-sized bell and place it on the electronicscale with rectangular base.

source.instruction: Grab the palm-sized bell and place it on the electronicscale with rectangular base.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the object, which was at x = -22 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm above the bell to (-22, -12, 94), point gripper downward, and orient yaw to 90 degrees.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+8, +7, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -13, 94) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left gripper halfway down towards the bell to z = 86.5 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -7) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +12 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -12, 87) opening 0.95; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower gripper down to grasp height around z = 77 cm and close gripper firmly on the bell.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +1, -9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -12, 78) opening 0.83; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift bell up to z = 93 cm to clear the table surface.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +15) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-22, -12, 92) opening 0.85; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move bell horizontally over the scale platform to (-13, 1, 88.5).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+9, +13, -4) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the scale

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-13, 1, 89) opening 0.85; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the bell onto the scale platform to z = 84.5 cm and release gripper.
